examples.name: first_game
examples.title: First Game
examples.description: A whole small game built only from presets, no code: collect twelve coins (two on moving platforms, two up a ramp), dodge spikes and a guard who chases you, then reach the goal before the timer runs out.

examples.name: collector_luau
examples.title: Collector
examples.description: A small complete game in Luau: run and jump around two arenas collecting gems, with a HUD, a pause menu, saves and two languages.

examples.name: third_person_scripted
examples.title: Third-person (Luau)
examples.description: The third-person template written as Luau scripts instead of behaviours: player, follow camera, pickups and HUD, every line commented.

examples.name: cinder_keep
examples.title: Cinder Keep
examples.description: A short third-person action-platformer in Luau: dialogue, sword combat, an enemy wave and imported glTF levels.

examples.name: ember_bridge
examples.title: Ember Bridge
examples.description: A puzzle made without code: carry embers to braziers to raise bridges. Interactable components with prompts, conditions and actions.

examples.name: script_rules
examples.title: Script Rules
examples.description: Two Luau rules build fences and a colonnade while you edit: drag the points, change the properties, edit the rule files.

examples.name: script_demo
examples.title: Script Demo
examples.description: A small scripted scene: a player, a follow camera, spinning gems and beacons.

examples.name: guide_samples
examples.title: Guide Samples
examples.description: Every sample of the user guides, playing: scripts, physics, animation, UI, saves and procedural rules in three scenes.
